    rBaselineOffset             : REAL := 0.0;      (* Constant pedestal parameter of baseline polynomial [mV] *)
    rO2_AbsorptionCrossSect     : REAL := 1.85E-21; (* Optical absorption cross-section per molecule [cm^2] *)
    rWaterVaporCrossTalkCoeff   : REAL := 0.0145;   (* Residual H2O absorption cross-sensitivity factor at 760.8nm *)

    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    (* 5.0 DUAL STARWHEEL REJECT CAMMING & CIRCULAR SHIFT REGISTERS                          *)

    arrPocketRejectCode         : ARRAY[1..64] OF INT;  (* 0=Pass, 1=Reject1 (Gross/O2), 2=Reject2 (Vac/H2O) *)

    c_iPocketOffset_Reject2     : INT := 34;        (* Pocket distance from inspection to Starwheel 2 blow-off *)
    c_rPneumaticValveLatency_ms : REAL := 4.5;      (* Solenoid valve electrical & pilot pneumatic firing delay [ms] *)
    c_rRejectPulseDuration_ms   : REAL := 16.0;     (* Commanded pneumatic blow-off nozzle open duration [ms] *)
    rReject1_TimerAccum_s       : REAL := 0.0;      (* Starwheel 1 valve open duration accumulator [s] *)
    rReject2_TimerAccum_s       : REAL := 0.0;      (* Starwheel 2 valve open duration accumulator [s] *)
    rReject1_Watchdog_s         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Starwheel 1 verification sensor timeout timer [s] *)

    bReject1_AwaitingConfirm    : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Starwheel 1 active rejection confirmation tracking flag *)

    iCurrentPocketIndex         : INT := 1;         (* Currently active inspection station pocket pointer [1..64] *)
    rPrevMasterEncoderAngle_deg : REAL := 0.0;      (* Historical encoder angle for pocket pitch indexing *)

    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    (* 6.0 DYNAMIC STATISTICAL PROCESS CONTROL (SPC) & RECURSIVE WELFORD ANALYTICS           *)
    (* Real-time rolling sample capability estimation across 64-vial moving batch window     *)
    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    arrSPC_O2_Buffer            : ARRAY[1..64] OF REAL; (* Circular FIFO buffer for valid O2 measurements *)
    arrSPC_Press_Buffer         : ARRAY[1..64] OF REAL; (* Circular FIFO buffer for valid pressure measurements *)
    iSPC_Index                  : INT := 1;         (* Circular buffer insertion pointer [1..64] *)
    iSPC_Count                  : INT := 0;         (* Validated samples accumulated in SPC buffer *)
    rWelford_Mean_O2            : REAL := 0.0;      (* Recursive online sample mean O2 [%] *)
    rWelford_M2_O2              : REAL := 0.0;      (* Recursive online second central moment M2 for O2 *)
    rWelford_Mean_Press         : REAL := 100.0;    (* Recursive online sample mean pressure [mbar] *)
    rWelford_M2_Press           : REAL := 0.0;      (* Recursive online second central moment M2 for pressure *)
    rCalculatedVariance_O2      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Sample variance s^2 for O2 *)
    rCalculatedVariance_Press   : REAL := 0.0;      (* Sample variance s^2 for pressure *)
    rCp_O2                      : REAL := 1.67;     (* Process potential capability Cp for O2 *)
    rCpk_Upper_O2               : REAL := 1.67;     (* Upper capability limit CpkU for O2 *)
    rCpk_Lower_O2               : REAL := 1.67;     (* Lower capability limit CpkL for O2 *)

    rCpk_Upper_Press            : REAL := 1.67;     (* Upper capability limit CpkU for pressure *)
    rCpk_Lower_Press            : REAL := 1.67;     (* Lower capability limit CpkL for pressure *)
    iNelsonRule2_RunCount_O2    : INT := 0;         (* Consecutive points on same side of mean (Rule 2) *)
    iNelsonRule3_TrendCount_O2  : INT := 0;         (* Consecutive points steadily increasing/decreasing (Rule 3) *)

    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    (* 7.0 TIMERS, DEBOUNCERS, EDGE DETECTORS & SCRATCH REGISTERS                            *)
    (* ===================================================================================== *)
    tonLaserWarmup              : TON;              (* DFB laser source startup ignition timer *)
    tonTEC_Stabilize            : TON;              (* Thermoelectric temperature stabilization debounce *)
    tonGateWatchdog             : TON;              (* Maximum optical transit inspection window timer *)
    tonPneumaticPressDebounce   : TON;              (* Reject air supply pressure drop debounce timer *)
    r_trig_VialDetect           : R_TRIG;           (* Vial presence rising edge trigger *)
    r_trig_PocketAdvance        : R_TRIG;           (* Main turret pitch index pulse *)
    r_trig_Acknowledge          : R_TRIG;           (* Fault reset pulse *)

    (* State Machine Transition Variables *)
    iState                      : INT := 0;         (* Active finite state machine index *)
    iPrevState                  : INT := 0;         (* Historical state machine index *)
    rStateTimerAccum_s          : REAL := 0.0;      (* Elapsed residence time in active state [s] *)
    iSpectralPointIndex         : INT := 1;         (* Sweep digitization sample counter [1..32] *)

    (* Non-Linear Least Squares Gauss-Newton Working Registers *)
    rGN_Jacobian_11 : REAL; rGN_Jacobian_12 : REAL; (* Approximated partial derivatives *)
    rGN_Hessian_11  : REAL; rGN_Hessian_12  : REAL; rGN_Hessian_22 : REAL;
    rGN_Grad_1      : REAL; rGN_Grad_2      : REAL;
    rGN_Delta_Amp   : REAL; rGN_Delta_Width : REAL;
    rGN_Det         : REAL;
    rFittedLorentzVal : REAL; rFittedGaussVal : REAL; rFrequencyOffsetVal : REAL;
    rResidualSquareSum : REAL;

    (* General Math Scratch Registers *)
    rTmpA : REAL; rTmpB : REAL; rTmpC : REAL; rTmpDiff : REAL;
    rGrad1 : REAL; rHess11 : REAL; rUnconstrainedDrive : REAL;
    iIdx : INT; jIdx : INT; kIdx : INT;
END_VAR

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY SHUTDOWN & SIL-3 HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                      *)
(* Hard real-time safety gating evaluated unconditionally at start of every 500 us task      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    bRejectGate1_Actuate := FALSE;
    bRejectGate2_Actuate := FALSE;
    rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: SIL-3 Hardwired E-Stop Relay Tripped *)
    dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_FFF0) OR 16#0000_0009; (* Status: E-Stop Decoupled *)
    iCurrentState := 100; (* Direct jump to fail-safe containment state *)
    iState := 100;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Class 1 Optical Enclosure Laser Safety Interlock Check *)
IF NOT bLaserSafetyInterlock THEN
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := 0.0;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Class 1 Laser Safety Enclosure Interlock Open *)
    iCurrentState := 100;
    iState := 100;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Pneumatic Reject Air Supply Header Pressure Supervision *)
tonPneumaticPressDebounce(IN := (rRejectAirSupply_bar < 4.8), PT := T#100MS);
IF tonPneumaticPressDebounce.Q THEN
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Pneumatic Blow-Off Header Pressure Exhausted (< 4.8 bar) *)
    iCurrentState := 100;
    iState := 100;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                             *)
(* Evaluates pair-wise Euclidean deviations, detects sensor drift, and flags degraded 1oo2.  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.1 Optical Absorption Photodiode Transimpedance Receiver 2oo3 Voting *)
bDet_A_OK := (rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV >= 50.0) AND (rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV <= 4950.0);
bDet_B_OK := (rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV >= 50.0) AND (rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV <= 4950.0);
bDet_C_OK := (rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV >= 50.0) AND (rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV <= 4950.0);

IF bDet_A_OK AND bDet_B_OK AND bDet_C_OK THEN
    (* All 3 channels operational: compute median value *)
    IF (rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV >= rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV AND rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV <= rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV) OR
       (rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV >= rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV AND rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV <= rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV) THEN
        rVotedPhotodiode_mV := rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV;
    ELSIF (rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV >= rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV AND rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV <= rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV) OR
          (rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV >= rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV AND rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV <= rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV) THEN
        rVotedPhotodiode_mV := rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV;
    ELSE
        rVotedPhotodiode_mV := rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV;
    END_IF;
    bDet_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    (* Check for channel calibration drift beyond tolerance *)
    IF (ABS(rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV - rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV) > c_rPhotodiodeTol_mV) OR
       (ABS(rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV - rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV) > c_rPhotodiodeTol_mV) OR
       (ABS(rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV - rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV) > c_rPhotodiodeTol_mV) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Photodiode TMR Channel Discrepancy Drift *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bDet_A_OK AND bDet_B_OK THEN
    rVotedPhotodiode_mV := (rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV + rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV) * 0.5;
    bDet_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Photodiode Channel C Failure (Degraded 1oo2 Mode) *)
ELSIF bDet_B_OK AND bDet_C_OK THEN
    rVotedPhotodiode_mV := (rPhotodiodeRaw_B_mV + rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV) * 0.5;
    bDet_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Photodiode Channel A Failure (Degraded 1oo2 Mode) *)
ELSIF bDet_A_OK AND bDet_C_OK THEN
    rVotedPhotodiode_mV := (rPhotodiodeRaw_A_mV + rPhotodiodeRaw_C_mV) * 0.5;
    bDet_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Photodiode Channel B Failure (Degraded 1oo2 Mode) *)
ELSE
    (* 2 or more photodiode channels failed: Optical acquisition loss *)
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Photodiode TMR Multiple Channel Catastrophic Failure *)
END_IF;
bTMR_Degraded_1oo2 := bDet_Degraded_1oo2 OR bTrig_Degraded_1oo2;

(* 2.2 Pocket Presence Proximity Trigger 2oo3 Voting *)
IF (bVialTrigger_A AND bVialTrigger_B) OR (bVialTrigger_B AND bVialTrigger_C) OR (bVialTrigger_A AND bVialTrigger_C) THEN
    bVotedVialTrigger := TRUE;
ELSE
    bVotedVialTrigger := FALSE;
END_IF;
r_trig_VialDetect(CLK := bVotedVialTrigger);

(* 2.3 Laser Substrate Temperature (TEC) Permissive Check *)
bLaserThermalStabilized := (ABS(rLaserDiodeTemp_DegC - 25.0) <= 0.015);
IF NOT bLaserThermalStabilized AND bEnableSystem THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Laser DFB Substrate Temperature Outside Operating Window *)
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 PIEZO-GALVANOMETER OPTICAL JITTER NULLING & STATE-SPACE MPC OBSERVER                   *)
(* Maintains laser beam centroid centered on the moving vial optical chord during transit    *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Innovation calculation from Position Sensitive Detector (PSD) measurement *)
rTrackingTrackingError_um := rBeamDeflection_PSD_um - x3_Pos_um;

(* Observer State Correction Step: x = x_pred + L * innovation *)
x1_Angle_mrad := x1_Pred + (L_11 * rTrackingTrackingError_um) + (L_12 * (rGalvoMirrorAngleFeedback_urad / 1000.0 - x1_Pred));
x2_Vel_mrad_s := x2_Pred + (L_21 * rTrackingTrackingError_um);
x3_Pos_um     := x3_Pred + (L_31 * rTrackingTrackingError_um);
x4_Vel_um_s   := x4_Pred + (L_41 * rTrackingTrackingError_um);
x5_Disturb_um := x5_Pred + (L_51 * rTrackingTrackingError_um);
x6_Integ_um_s := x6_Pred + (rTrackingTrackingError_um * c_rCycleTimeSeconds);

(* Constrained Quadratic Programming MPC Drive Computation *)
(* Analytical unconstrained gradient step J = 1/2 u'*H*u + g'*u *)
rHess11 := (Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_Pos * Bd_31) + (Bd_41 * rMPC_Weight_Vel * Bd_41) +
           (Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_Angle * Bd_11) + (Bd_61 * rMPC_Weight_Integ * Bd_61) +
           rMPC_Weight_Drive + (rMPC_Weight_Rate / (c_rCycleTimeSeconds * c_rCycleTimeSeconds));

rGrad1  := (Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_Pos * (x3_Pos_um + x5_Disturb_um)) +
           (Bd_41 * rMPC_Weight_Vel * x4_Vel_um_s) +
           (Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_Angle * x1_Angle_mrad) +
           (Bd_61 * rMPC_Weight_Integ * x6_Integ_um_s) -
           ((rMPC_Weight_Rate / (c_rCycleTimeSeconds * c_rCycleTimeSeconds)) * rPrevGalvoDrive_mV);

IF rHess11 > 0.0001 THEN
    rUnconstrainedDrive := - (rGrad1 / rHess11);
ELSE
    rUnconstrainedDrive := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Slew Rate Limiter Clamping (3,000,000 mV/s = 1500 mV per 500 us scan) *)
rTmpDiff := rUnconstrainedDrive - rPrevGalvoDrive_mV;
IF rTmpDiff > 1500.0 THEN
    rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := rPrevGalvoDrive_mV + 1500.0;
ELSIF rTmpDiff < -1500.0 THEN
    rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := rPrevGalvoDrive_mV - 1500.0;
ELSE
    rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := rUnconstrainedDrive;
END_IF;

(* Absolute Drive Voltage Saturation Limiter (+/- 10,000 mV) *)
IF rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand > rMaxGalvoDrive_mV THEN
    rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := rMaxGalvoDrive_mV;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: Piezo-Galvo Drive Command Saturated High *)
ELSIF rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand < -rMaxGalvoDrive_mV THEN
    rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := -rMaxGalvoDrive_mV;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0020;
END_IF;
rPrevGalvoDrive_mV := rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand;

(* Optical Alignment Lock Verification *)
bOpticalAlignmentLocked := (ABS(rTrackingTrackingError_um) <= 12.0) AND (rBeamIntensity_PSD_mV > 1500.0);

(* Discrete State-Space Propagation Step: x_pred = Ad * x + Bd * u *)
x1_Pred := (Ad_11 * x1_Angle_mrad) + (Ad_12 * x2_Vel_mrad_s) + (Bd_11 * rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand);
x2_Pred := (Ad_21 * x1_Angle_mrad) + (Ad_22 * x2_Vel_mrad_s) + (Bd_21 * rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand);
x3_Pred := (Ad_31 * x1_Angle_mrad) + (Ad_32 * x2_Vel_mrad_s) + (Ad_33 * x3_Pos_um) + (Ad_34 * x4_Vel_um_s) + (Ad_35 * x5_Disturb_um) + (Bd_31 * rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand);
x4_Pred := (Ad_41 * x1_Angle_mrad) + (Ad_42 * x2_Vel_mrad_s) + (Ad_43 * x3_Pos_um) + (Ad_44 * x4_Vel_um_s) + (Ad_45 * x5_Disturb_um) + (Bd_41 * rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand);
x5_Pred := (Ad_55 * x5_Disturb_um);
x6_Pred := (Ad_61 * x1_Angle_mrad) + (Ad_63 * x3_Pos_um) + (Ad_66 * x6_Integ_um_s) + (Bd_61 * rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iState OF)                                     *)
(* Hard real-time orchestration across 10 deterministic supervisory & spectroscopic states   *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE_SYSTEM_INIT_AND_DIAGNOSTICS *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bRejectGate1_Actuate := FALSE;
        bRejectGate2_Actuate := FALSE;
        rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := 0.0;
        x1_Pred := 0.0; x2_Pred := 0.0; x3_Pred := 0.0; x4_Pred := 0.0; x5_Pred := 0.0; x6_Pred := 0.0;
        (* Reset Pocket Circular Shift Registers *)
        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 64 DO
            arrPocketOccupied[iIdx] := FALSE;
            arrPocketInspectionDone[iIdx] := FALSE;
            arrPocketRejectCode[iIdx] := 0;
            arrPocketO2_Val[iIdx] := 0.0;
            arrPocketPress_Val[iIdx] := 0.0;
            arrPocketLatchAngle_deg[iIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        (* Reset Spectral Scan Arrays *)
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 32 DO
            arrSpectralSweep_mV[jIdx] := 0.0;
            arrWavelengthDetune_GHz[jIdx] := -3.10 + (DINT_TO_REAL(jIdx - 1) * 0.20); (* -3.1 to +3.1 GHz grid *)
            arrBaselineCorrected_mV[jIdx] := 0.0;
            arrFittedVoigt_mV[jIdx] := 0.0;
            arrResidualError_mV[jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        IF bEmergencyStop AND bLaserSafetyInterlock THEN
            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_LASER_TEC_WARMUP_STABILIZATION *)
        tonLaserWarmup(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);
        tonTEC_Stabilize(IN := bLaserThermalStabilized, PT := T#2S);
        IF tonLaserWarmup.Q AND tonTEC_Stabilize.Q THEN
            tonLaserWarmup(IN := FALSE);
            tonTEC_Stabilize(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_REFERENCE_GAS_CELL_AUTO_CALIBRATION *)
        (* Verify sealed 21.0% O2 standard cell and pure N2 zero cell absorption ratio *)
        IF (rRefCellO2_Signal_mV >= 1500.0) AND (rRefCellZero_Signal_mV <= 250.0) THEN
            iState := 30;
        ELSE
            dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Optical Reference Cell Calibration Span Error *)
            iState := 30; (* Proceed to Standby with advisory flag *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_STANDBY_WAIT_INSPECTION_ENABLE *)
        bSystemReady := bLaserThermalStabilized AND bStarwheelSyncPermissive AND (rRejectAirSupply_bar >= 5.2);
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := 0.0;
        IF bEnableSystem AND bSystemReady THEN
            bSystemRunning := TRUE;
            iState := 40;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_VIAL_POCKET_ACQUISITION_AND_TRACKING *)
        (* Detect vial presence entering optical transit gate *)
        IF r_trig_VialDetect.Q OR bManualInspectionGateForce THEN
            arrPocketOccupied[iCurrentPocketIndex] := TRUE;
            arrPocketInspectionDone[iCurrentPocketIndex] := FALSE;
            arrPocketRejectCode[iCurrentPocketIndex] := 0;
            arrPocketLatchAngle_deg[iCurrentPocketIndex] := rMasterEncoderAngle_deg;
            iSpectralPointIndex := 1;
            rStateTimerAccum_s := 0.0;
            iState := 50;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_FAST_TDLAS_BURST_AND_PIEZO_MPC *)
        (* High-speed burst sampling: Acquire 32-point 2f absorption profile while tracking *)
        arrSpectralSweep_mV[iSpectralPointIndex] := rVotedPhotodiode_mV;
        iSpectralPointIndex := iSpectralPointIndex + 1;
        rStateTimerAccum_s := rStateTimerAccum_s + c_rCycleTimeSeconds;
        IF (iSpectralPointIndex > 32) OR (rStateTimerAccum_s >= (rInspectionGateTime_ms / 1000.0)) THEN
            iState := 60;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_VOIGT_SPECTRAL_DECONVOLUTION *)
        (* Execute mathematical separation of Lorentzian pressure broadening & Oxygen concentration *)
        (* Step 6.1: Baseline polynomial extraction from wings *)
        rBaselineOffset := (arrSpectralSweep_mV[1] + arrSpectralSweep_mV[2] + arrSpectralSweep_mV[31] + arrSpectralSweep_mV[32]) * 0.25;
        rBaselineSlope  := (arrSpectralSweep_mV[32] - arrSpectralSweep_mV[1]) / 6.20;
        rPeakAbsorption2f_mV := 0.0;
        FOR kIdx := 1 TO 32 DO
            arrBaselineCorrected_mV[kIdx] := arrSpectralSweep_mV[kIdx] - (rBaselineOffset + (rBaselineSlope * arrWavelengthDetune_GHz[kIdx]));
            IF arrBaselineCorrected_mV[kIdx] > rPeakAbsorption2f_mV THEN
                rPeakAbsorption2f_mV := arrBaselineCorrected_mV[kIdx];
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        rOpticalAbsorptionPeak_2f := rPeakAbsorption2f_mV;

        (* Step 6.2: Doppler Broadening FWHM from temperature *)
        rDopplerFWHM_GHz := c_rLaserCenterFrequency_THz * SQRT((8.0 * LN(2.0) * c_rBoltzmannConstant * (rLaserDiodeTemp_DegC + 273.15)) / (c_rOxygenMolecularMass_kg * c_rSpeedOfLight * c_rSpeedOfLight)) * 1000.0;

        (* Step 6.3: Non-linear Gauss-Newton deconvolution of Lorentzian FWHM *)
        rLorentzFWHM_GHz := 0.320; (* Initial iteration guess *)
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO (* 3 fast Gauss-Newton refinement steps *)
            rGN_Hessian_11 := 0.001;
            rGN_Grad_1     := 0.0;
            FOR kIdx := 8 TO 24 DO (* Core absorption feature index span *)
                rFrequencyOffsetVal := arrWavelengthDetune_GHz[kIdx];
                (* Pseudo-Voigt combination approximation *)
                rTmpA := 1.0 + (4.0 * (rFrequencyOffsetVal * rFrequencyOffsetVal) / (rLorentzFWHM_GHz * rLorentzFWHM_GHz));
                rFittedLorentzVal := rPeakAbsorption2f_mV / rTmpA;
                rTmpDiff := arrBaselineCorrected_mV[kIdx] - rFittedLorentzVal;
                rGN_Jacobian_11 := (8.0 * rPeakAbsorption2f_mV * rFrequencyOffsetVal * rFrequencyOffsetVal) / (rLorentzFWHM_GHz * rLorentzFWHM_GHz * rLorentzFWHM_GHz * rTmpA * rTmpA);
                rGN_Hessian_11 := rGN_Hessian_11 + (rGN_Jacobian_11 * rGN_Jacobian_11);
                rGN_Grad_1 := rGN_Grad_1 + (rGN_Jacobian_11 * rTmpDiff);
            END_FOR;
            IF rGN_Hessian_11 > 0.0001 THEN
                rGN_Delta_Width := rGN_Grad_1 / rGN_Hessian_11;
                IF rGN_Delta_Width > 0.15 THEN rGN_Delta_Width := 0.15; END_IF;
                IF rGN_Delta_Width < -0.15 THEN rGN_Delta_Width := -0.15; END_IF;
                rLorentzFWHM_GHz := rLorentzFWHM_GHz + rGN_Delta_Width;
            END_IF;
            IF rLorentzFWHM_GHz < 0.050 THEN rLorentzFWHM_GHz := 0.050; END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        rLorentzBroadeningHWHM := rLorentzFWHM_GHz * 0.5;

        (* Step 6.4: Effective Optical Path Length Calculation through cylindrical vial *)
        rTmpA := (rVialDiameter_mm * 0.5) - rVialWallThickness_mm; (* Internal radius *)
        rTmpB := ABS(x3_Pos_um) / 1000.0; (* Transverse beam offset in mm *)
        IF rTmpA > rTmpB THEN
            rCalculatedOptPathLength_mm := 2.0 * SQRT((rTmpA * rTmpA) - (rTmpB * rTmpB));
        ELSE
            rCalculatedOptPathLength_mm := (rVialDiameter_mm * 0.5);
        END_IF;

        (* Step 6.5: Inversion to Total Absolute Headspace Pressure [mbar] *)
        (* gamma_L = (P / P0) * (T0 / T)^n * gamma_air *)
        rTmpC := EXPT(c_rRefTempKelvin_T0 / (rLaserDiodeTemp_DegC + 273.15), c_rTemperatureExponent_n);
        IF rTmpC > 0.001 AND c_rAirBroadenedCoeff_HWHM > 0.001 THEN
            rCalculatedHeadspacePress := (rLorentzBroadeningHWHM / (c_rAirBroadenedCoeff_HWHM * rTmpC)) * c_rRefPressMbar_P0;
        ELSE
            rCalculatedHeadspacePress := 100.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Step 6.6: Inversion to Headspace Oxygen Concentration [%] via Beer-Lambert Area *)
        IF rCalculatedOptPathLength_mm > 1.0 AND rCalculatedHeadspacePress > 5.0 THEN
            rCalculatedO2Concentration := (rPeakAbsorption2f_mV * rLorentzFWHM_GHz) / (rCalculatedOptPathLength_mm * (rCalculatedHeadspacePress / c_rRefPressMbar_P0) * 1.85);
        ELSE
            rCalculatedO2Concentration := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        IF rCalculatedO2Concentration < 0.0 THEN rCalculatedO2Concentration := 0.0; END_IF;
        IF rCalculatedO2Concentration > 25.0 THEN rCalculatedO2Concentration := 25.0; END_IF;

        (* Step 6.7: Residual Moisture (H2O) Estimation from 760.3nm shoulder *)
        rCalculatedH2OConcentration := ABS(arrSpectralSweep_mV[5] - rBaselineOffset) * c_rWaterVaporCrossTalkCoeff;
        IF rCalculatedH2OConcentration > 10.0 THEN rCalculatedH2OConcentration := 10.0; END_IF;

        iState := 70;

    70: (* STATE_PASS_FAIL_CLASSIFICATION *)
        diTotalInspectedCount := diTotalInspectedCount + 1;
        arrPocketO2_Val[iCurrentPocketIndex] := rCalculatedO2Concentration;
        arrPocketPress_Val[iCurrentPocketIndex] := rCalculatedHeadspacePress;
        arrPocketInspectionDone[iCurrentPocketIndex] := TRUE;

        (* Dual Starwheel Classification Rule Hierarchy *)
        IF rCalculatedO2Concentration >= rO2RejectThreshold_Pct THEN
            (* Rejection Priority 1: High O2 / Gross Atmospheric Ingress -> Starwheel 1 *)
            arrPocketRejectCode[iCurrentPocketIndex] := 1;
            diTotalReject1Count := diTotalReject1Count + 1;
            bVialInspectedPass := FALSE;
        ELSIF (rCalculatedHeadspacePress < rPressMinLimit_mbar) OR (rCalculatedHeadspacePress > rPressMaxLimit_mbar) OR
              (rCalculatedH2OConcentration >= rH2ORejectThreshold_Pct) THEN
            (* Rejection Priority 2: Loss of Vacuum or High Moisture -> Starwheel 2 *)
            arrPocketRejectCode[iCurrentPocketIndex] := 2;
            diTotalReject2Count := diTotalReject2Count + 1;
            bVialInspectedPass := FALSE;
        ELSE
            (* Good Vial: Continues through main turret to outfeed transfer *)
            arrPocketRejectCode[iCurrentPocketIndex] := 0;
            bVialInspectedPass := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        iState := 80;

    80: (* STATE_SPC_UPDATE_CAM_SYNC *)
        (* Recursive Welford SPC Update for in-control production vials *)
        IF bVialInspectedPass THEN
            iSPC_Count := iSPC_Count + 1;
            IF iSPC_Count = 1 THEN
                rWelford_Mean_O2 := rCalculatedO2Concentration;
                rWelford_M2_O2 := 0.0;
                rWelford_Mean_Press := rCalculatedHeadspacePress;
                rWelford_M2_Press := 0.0;
            ELSE
                rTmpA := rCalculatedO2Concentration - rWelford_Mean_O2;
                rWelford_Mean_O2 := rWelford_Mean_O2 + (rTmpA / DINT_TO_REAL(iSPC_Count));
                rWelford_M2_O2 := rWelford_M2_O2 + (rTmpA * (rCalculatedO2Concentration - rWelford_Mean_O2));
                rTmpB := rCalculatedHeadspacePress - rWelford_Mean_Press;
                rWelford_Mean_Press := rWelford_Mean_Press + (rTmpB / DINT_TO_REAL(iSPC_Count));
                rWelford_M2_Press := rWelford_M2_Press + (rTmpB * (rCalculatedHeadspacePress - rWelford_Mean_Press));
            END_IF;
            arrSPC_O2_Buffer[iSPC_Index] := rCalculatedO2Concentration;
            arrSPC_Press_Buffer[iSPC_Index] := rCalculatedHeadspacePress;
            iSPC_Index := iSPC_Index + 1;
            IF iSPC_Index > 64 THEN iSPC_Index := 1; END_IF;
        END_IF;
        iState := 40; (* Ready for next pocket acquisition *)

    90: (* STATE_DEGRADED_OPERATION_FALLBACK *)
        bDegradedControlMode := TRUE;
        (* Lead-Lag fallback tracking filter if MPC observer diverges *)
        rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := - (rBeamDeflection_PSD_um * 4.5);
        IF bAcknowledgeFault THEN
            bDegradedControlMode := FALSE;
            iState := 40;
        END_IF;

    100: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN_AND_TRIP *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bRejectGate1_Actuate := FALSE;
        bRejectGate2_Actuate := FALSE;
        rPiezoGalvoDriveDemand := 0.0;
        IF bAcknowledgeFault AND bEmergencyStop AND bLaserSafetyInterlock THEN
            bSystemTrip := FALSE;
            dwAlarmWord_1 := 16#0000_0000;
            dwAlarmWord_2 := 16#0000_0000;
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;
END_CASE;
iCurrentState := iState;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 DUAL STARWHEEL REJECT CAMMING & ELECTRONIC GEARING EXECUTION                          *)
(* Evaluated every 500 us task cycle to trigger high-speed pneumatic reject solenoids        *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Pocket advance indexing detection based on rotary turret encoder delta *)
rTmpDiff := rMasterEncoderAngle_deg - rPrevMasterEncoderAngle_deg;
IF rTmpDiff < -180.0 THEN rTmpDiff := rTmpDiff + 360.0; END_IF; (* Wrap-around at 360 deg *)
IF rTmpDiff >= 5.625 THEN (* 360 degrees / 64 pockets = 5.625 degrees per pocket *)
    iCurrentPocketIndex := iCurrentPocketIndex + 1;
    IF iCurrentPocketIndex > 64 THEN iCurrentPocketIndex := 1; END_IF;
    rPrevMasterEncoderAngle_deg := rMasterEncoderAngle_deg;
END_IF;

(* Starwheel 1 Reject Inspection Gate (Gross Leak / High O2: Pocket Offset = 18) *)
jIdx := iCurrentPocketIndex - c_iPocketOffset_Reject1;
IF jIdx < 1 THEN jIdx := jIdx + 64; END_IF;
IF arrPocketOccupied[jIdx] AND (arrPocketRejectCode[jIdx] = 1) THEN
    bRejectGate1_Actuate := TRUE;
    rReject1_TimerAccum_s := rReject1_TimerAccum_s + c_rCycleTimeSeconds;
    IF rReject1_TimerAccum_s >= (c_rRejectPulseDuration_ms / 1000.0) THEN
        bRejectGate1_Actuate := FALSE;
        arrPocketOccupied[jIdx] := FALSE; (* Vial ejected into Starwheel 1 chute *)
        rReject1_TimerAccum_s := 0.0;
        bReject1_AwaitingConfirm := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bRejectGate1_Actuate := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Starwheel 1 Rejection Optical Confirmation Verification *)
IF bReject1_AwaitingConfirm THEN
    rReject1_Watchdog_s := rReject1_Watchdog_s + c_rCycleTimeSeconds;
    IF bReject1_ConfirmOptical THEN
        bReject1_AwaitingConfirm := FALSE;
        rReject1_Watchdog_s := 0.0;
    ELSIF rReject1_Watchdog_s >= 0.080 THEN (* 80 ms confirmation window *)
        (* Fail-to-Reject Emergency Stop: Critical Integrity Violation *)
        bSystemTrip := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Starwheel 1 Fail-to-Reject Fault *)
        bReject1_AwaitingConfirm := FALSE;
        rReject1_Watchdog_s := 0.0;
        iState := 100;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Starwheel 2 Reject Inspection Gate (Loss of Vacuum / Moisture: Pocket Offset = 34) *)
kIdx := iCurrentPocketIndex - c_iPocketOffset_Reject2;
IF kIdx < 1 THEN kIdx := kIdx + 64; END_IF;
IF arrPocketOccupied[kIdx] AND (arrPocketRejectCode[kIdx] = 2) THEN
    bRejectGate2_Actuate := TRUE;
    rReject2_TimerAccum_s := rReject2_TimerAccum_s + c_rCycleTimeSeconds;
    IF rReject2_TimerAccum_s >= (c_rRejectPulseDuration_ms / 1000.0) THEN
        bRejectGate2_Actuate := FALSE;
        arrPocketOccupied[kIdx] := FALSE; (* Vial ejected into Starwheel 2 chute *)
        rReject2_TimerAccum_s := 0.0;
        bReject2_AwaitingConfirm := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bRejectGate2_Actuate := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Starwheel 2 Rejection Optical Confirmation Verification *)
IF bReject2_AwaitingConfirm THEN
    rReject2_Watchdog_s := rReject2_Watchdog_s + c_rCycleTimeSeconds;
    IF bReject2_ConfirmOptical THEN
        bReject2_AwaitingConfirm := FALSE;
        rReject2_Watchdog_s := 0.0;
    ELSIF rReject2_Watchdog_s >= 0.080 THEN
        bSystemTrip := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: Starwheel 2 Fail-to-Reject Fault *)
        bReject2_AwaitingConfirm := FALSE;
        rReject2_Watchdog_s := 0.0;
        iState := 100;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 DYNAMIC STATISTICAL PROCESS CONTROL (SPC) & CPK ANALYTICS ENGINE                      *)
(* Computes real-time process capability and evaluates Western Electric rule violations      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF iSPC_Count >= 10 THEN
    rRollingMean_O2 := rWelford_Mean_O2;
    rRollingMean_Press := rWelford_Mean_Press;
    rCalculatedVariance_O2 := rWelford_M2_O2 / DINT_TO_REAL(iSPC_Count - 1);
    rCalculatedVariance_Press := rWelford_M2_Press / DINT_TO_REAL(iSPC_Count - 1);
    IF rCalculatedVariance_O2 > 0.000001 THEN
        rRollingStdDev_O2 := SQRT(rCalculatedVariance_O2);
    ELSE
        rRollingStdDev_O2 := 0.001;
    END_IF;
    IF rCalculatedVariance_Press > 0.0001 THEN
        rRollingStdDev_Press := SQRT(rCalculatedVariance_Press);
    ELSE
        rRollingStdDev_Press := 0.100;
    END_IF;

    (* Oxygen Capability Metrics (USL = rO2_USL_Pct, LSL = 0.0) *)
    rCp_O2 := (rO2_USL_Pct - rO2_LSL_Pct) / (6.0 * rRollingStdDev_O2);
    rCpk_Upper_O2 := (rO2_USL_Pct - rRollingMean_O2) / (3.0 * rRollingStdDev_O2);
    rCpk_Lower_O2 := (rRollingMean_O2 - rO2_LSL_Pct) / (3.0 * rRollingStdDev_O2);
    IF rCpk_Upper_O2 < rCpk_Lower_O2 THEN
        rRealtimeCpk_O2 := rCpk_Upper_O2;
    ELSE
        rRealtimeCpk_O2 := rCpk_Lower_O2;
    END_IF;

    (* Vacuum Pressure Capability Metrics *)
    rCp_Press := (rPress_USL_mbar - rPress_LSL_mbar) / (6.0 * rRollingStdDev_Press);
    rCpk_Upper_Press := (rPress_USL_mbar - rRollingMean_Press) / (3.0 * rRollingStdDev_Press);
    rCpk_Lower_Press := (rRollingMean_Press - rPress_LSL_mbar) / (3.0 * rRollingStdDev_Press);
    IF rCpk_Upper_Press < rCpk_Lower_Press THEN
        rRealtimeCpk_Press := rCpk_Upper_Press;
    ELSE
        rRealtimeCpk_Press := rCpk_Lower_Press;
    END_IF;

    (* Western Electric Rule 2 (Run of 9 consecutive points on same side of mean) *)
    IF rCalculatedO2Concentration > rRollingMean_O2 THEN
        IF iNelsonRule2_RunCount_O2 >= 0 THEN
            iNelsonRule2_RunCount_O2 := iNelsonRule2_RunCount_O2 + 1;
        ELSE
            iNelsonRule2_RunCount_O2 := 1;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF iNelsonRule2_RunCount_O2 <= 0 THEN
            iNelsonRule2_RunCount_O2 := iNelsonRule2_RunCount_O2 - 1;
        ELSE
            iNelsonRule2_RunCount_O2 := -1;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
    IF ABS(iNelsonRule2_RunCount_O2) >= 9 THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Bit 7: Western Electric Rule 2 Violation (O2 Bias Shift) *)
    END_IF;

    (* Dynamic Capability Interlocks *)
    IF (rRealtimeCpk_O2 < 1.33) OR (rRealtimeCpk_Press < 1.33) THEN
        bSPCLotWarning_Cpk := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Bit 8: Statistical Capability Warning Cpk < 1.33 *)
    ELSE
        bSPCLotWarning_Cpk := FALSE;
    END_IF;

    IF (rRealtimeCpk_O2 < 1.00) OR (rRealtimeCpk_Press < 1.00) THEN
        bSPCLotAlarm_Trip := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Statistical Capability Trip Cpk < 1.00 *)
    ELSE
        bSPCLotAlarm_Trip := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 BIT-PACKED STATUS WORD SYNTHESIS FOR INDUSTRIAL ETHERNET TELEMETRY                    *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000_0000;
IF bSystemRunning THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0001; END_IF;
IF bSystemReady THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0002; END_IF;
IF bSystemTrip THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0004; END_IF;
IF bDegradedControlMode THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0008; END_IF;
IF bTMR_Degraded_1oo2 THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0010; END_IF;
IF bLaserThermalStabilized THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0020; END_IF;
IF bOpticalAlignmentLocked THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0040; END_IF;
IF bVialInspectedPass THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0080; END_IF;
IF bSPCLotWarning_Cpk THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0100; END_IF;
IF bSPCLotAlarm_Trip THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0200; END_IF;
IF bRejectGate1_Actuate THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0400; END_IF;
IF bRejectGate2_Actuate THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0800; END_IF;
dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR SHL(INT_TO_DWORD(iCurrentState), 16);
